AMENDMENT NO. 1 dated as of October 15, 2026 to the Credit Agreement dated as of August 20, 2026, among Granite Peak Fabrication, Inc., as Borrower, the Lenders party hereto and Silverline Bank, as Administrative Agent.

SECTION 1. Amendments . The definition of "Foreign Subsidiary" in Section 1.01 of the Credit Agreement is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows: "Foreign Subsidiary" means any Subsidiary that is organized under the laws of a jurisdiction other than the United States of America or Canada.

SECTION 2. Effectiveness . This Amendment shall become effective on October 15, 2026.
